# GoodWidget instructions for Copilot

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before starting work. It contains the shared
contribution, planning, coding, testing and review rules for people and agents. Open the
central contribution guide and task references it requires; links do not load themselves.

For Copilot cloud setup, see [copilot-setup-steps.yml](workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml).
Check the actual setup result before relying on installed dependencies or build outputs.
Use the [demo environment guide](../docs/demo-environment.md) for Storybook and Playwright.
